transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm Tom. Well, I'm here because I'm having a real problem with eating. What scares me most is that once I start eating, it feels like my hands just keep reaching for more... even while I’m telling myself, Tom, stop this right now. I just can't seem to control it once I get going.
After these episodes where you feel out of control with your eating, do you take any specific actions to try to prevent weight gain, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

Yes. After I eat too much like that... I go to the bathroom and make myself bring it back up. And I’ve also taken laxatives, too. I just get so scared that all that food is going to stay in me, so I feel like I have to do those things to get it out.

latest_inference.note: The patient's report of compensatory behaviors (purging and laxative use) following episodes of binge eating strongly points to Bulimia Nervosa, ruling out F50.8 (Other eating disorders) and F50.9 (Unspecified).
